headline: Lease of devices for teachers from Apple, Inc., $375,497.83, approved
summary: The lease covers 1,750 devices, and Apple raised its price $50 per unit. City rules require council approval for leases longer than 3 years, and that approval is being sought. Monthly spending reports were also approved, along with a donation from the Justin J. Watt Foundation and other routine items.
decisions: Approved the Permission to Enter, including the $375,497.83 Apple, Inc. lease, 5 yes, 2 absent.
Approved monthly year-to-date spending updates for all general fund line items, 5 yes, 2 absent.
Approved the home education list without Kayla Castillo, 5 yes, 2 absent.
Approved accepting and spending allocated FY 27 awards, 5 yes, 2 absent.
Approved accepting the donation from the Justin J. Watt Foundation, 5 yes, 2 absent.
Approved conference and convention requests 10.1 to 10.4, 5 yes, 2 absent.
Approved the overnight out-of-state conference request for ESEA in February of 2027, 5 yes, 2 absent.
discussion: Apple device lease: Members questioned putting the lease on the agenda before a full vote, and some called it a shortcut. Apple had raised the device price $50 per unit and asked for a commitment.
Monthly spending reports: Members supported adding year-to-date spending updates to the packet each month, citing difficult budget times.
Stoklosa conference: Members asked why the overnight trip was needed. The answer given was a National Award Conference, where the school will officially receive recognition and an award.
